guard: a minted agent credential can delete only its client-managed ordered consumers on the public presence and channel-registry KV streams

mutations.name: drop the agent presence-watch consumer cleanup grant
mutations.expectRed: delete an ordered presence-watch consumer ALLOWED (watch reset/stop cleanup)
mutations.cell: delete an ordered presence-watch consumer ALLOWED (watch reset/stop cleanup)

mutations.name: drop the agent channel-registry-watch consumer cleanup grant
mutations.expectRed: delete an ordered channel-registry-watch consumer ALLOWED (watch reset/stop cleanup)
mutations.cell: delete an ordered channel-registry-watch consumer ALLOWED (watch reset/stop cleanup)
